svg.title: #44 0 SULLIVAN RD, College Park (18.6 ac tax roll)
svg.text: #44 0 SULLIVAN RD, College Park (18.6 ac tax roll)
rear-load 230 deep, court + trailer row, cars along office wall
Trailer stalls 19 (court rows 19, drop yard 0) vs target 19
Site 17.8 ac (county map) 10,600 SF/gross ac FAR 0.24
Access: truck (T) + car (C); local road, GDOT route 1121200056705;
Graded area: relief ~37 ft, balanced cut/fill ~30,000 CY, steep 4%
!! HEIGHT_CAP: draft height cap 35 ft: clear height lowered to 25
! SHORT_THROAT: truck throat about 14 ft from the street to the
! STREET_FACING_DOCKS: a truck court faces the street within 100
! RELIEF: about 37 ft of relief across the graded area: terraces
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for college park; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i POND_SITE_FROM_LIDAR: pond placed low, near the module and on
its side of mapped wetlands; no outfall, maintenance drive or
paving envelope (draft setbacks/buffers, 25 ft from water)
Screening test fit from public data: not a survey, civil design or zoning
determination. Zoning values are draft; detention is a +/-30% estimate;
routes, fire access and grading are indicative.
